nodes.long_description:
Step into the darkness like never before. 

You and your friends are stranded deep in a haunted forest where every night brings new horrors. Build, craft, and survive together — or watch your teammates vanish into the shadows.

Use your hands to light fires, gather supplies, and fight off what’s lurking in the woods. Feel the tension rise as you listen for footsteps... Was that your friend — or something else?

With full VR immersion, every sound, every flicker of light, and every scream feels real. Team up, stay close, and survive the endless nights — if you can.

Key Features:

🎮 Social Survival Experience
A multiplayer survival game where teamwork, chaos, and fun moments happen naturally with real players.

🔁 Infinite Night Challenge
There is no final level. Each night becomes more dangerous with new enemies and events. How many nights can your squad survive?

🏕️ Day & Night Survival Loop
Day: explore, loot, build, prepare
Night: defend, run, hide, survive

🦍 Natural Physical Movement
Move through the forest with your own body — climbing, jumping, and swinging with smooth, physical motion for deeper immersion.

🧲 Full Physics Interaction
Everything is real: pick up, throw, stack, block, and build using physics. Every match creates funny and chaotic moments.

🎥 Perfect for Streaming & Clips
Every session creates moments worth sharing: screams, laughs, fails, and clutch saves.

nodes.change_log:
Version 0.1.12:

The camp keeps growing — and this update brings new ways to play, move, and connect 🌲🔥

Here’s what’s new:

✨ New:

- Girl Skin
A brand new girl skin is now available for free! Jump in and try a fresh new look.

- Occultist Movement Upgrade
Occultists can now jump over vertical obstacles — giving you more freedom to escape, chase, and explore.

💬 Discord Update + Reward

We’ve updated our Discord server name — and everyone who joins gets 20 diamonds 💎

Join, grab your reward, and stay connected with updates and the community!

https://discord.gg/scoutcamp

⚙️ Improvements:

- Preparation for Daily Rewards
The game is now ready for the upcoming Daily Rewards system — coming very soon 👀

🛠️ Fixes:

Various bug fixes and stability improvements

---
Version 0.1.10:

The camp keeps growing — and this update brings a brand new activity to explore 🌲🔥

Here’s what’s new:

✨ New:

- Rope Park
Explore the new rope park area in the camp! Climb, balance, and test your skills high above the ground while earning extra rewards.

- Special Mini-Game Bonus
Take on a special mini-game challenge and prove you’re the best!

---
Version 0.1.8:

Here’s what’s new:

🛠️Fixes:

- Deer Hunter Bundle Fix
Fixed an issue where the Deer Hunter Bundle was not being granted correctly.

- Item Duplication Fix
Fixed a bug where existing items could be duplicated.

- Leaderboard Fix
Fixed an issue where not all data was displayed if you weren’t in the top 12 — now your stats are always visible.

⚙️ Improvements:

- Improved Keyboard Input
Enhanced keyboard responsiveness for smoother and more reliable controls.

- Quick Join Button
Added a new button on the keyboard to instantly connect to a random existing room.

✨New:

- Nights Counter Icon
Added a new icon above players in the lobby showing how many nights they’ve survived.

- Placement Hint Added
Added an in-game hint explaining that you can adjust an object’s position before placing it.

We continue improving Scout Camp step by step — more features, content, and surprises are coming soon.

---
Version 0.1.6:

The camp is evolving — and this update brings important improvements to gameplay, stability, and overall experience. 🌲🔥

Here’s what’s new:

🎒 New Default Skin

The default character is now a Scout — fully aligned with the world of Scout Camp.

🏆 Improved Leaderboards

Leaderboards are now more informative and dynamic:

- More player slots displayed
- Top players are highlighted
- You’ll always see your position, even if you're not in the top list

💾 Better Leaderboard Progress Saving

Your progress is now saved after each night, so you won’t lose your survival progress if something goes wrong.

🎯 Game Start Zones Reworked

💀 Death Icon Fix
When a player is eliminated, their proper death icon is now displayed instead of a white square.

🎒 Item Drop on Death
When you die, all items from your backpack — including bandages and medkits — will now drop properly.

🔌 Connection UI Fix
Removed incorrect “disconnected” messages when transitioning from lobby to game.

We continue improving Scout Camp step by step — more features, content, and surprises are coming soon.

Join our Discord and share your feedback:

💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/zZx2wxtRzv

📧 Support & Feedback: info@dream-dev.com

See you in the forest 🌲

----
Version 0.1.4:

Welcome to Scout Camp: Infinite Nights! 🌲🔥

This is the very first public release, and we’re thrilled to finally open the camp gates for you. 

Scout Camp: Infinite Nights is launching in Early Access because the adventure is just beginning. 

Over the coming months, we’ll be evolving the world with new mechanics, maps, events, and gameplay features — all shaped by your feedback.

What to expect in this version:

🌲 Survive the Night: The forest changes when the sun goes down. 

Your main goal is simple: survive until dawn. Use the environment, hide, and keep your wits about you.

🤝 Teamwork or Solo: Stick together with other scouts to increase your chances. Every night is a new challenge.

🕹️ Physics-Based Movement: Master the unique movement system to navigate the camp, climb structures, and evade what's lurking in the dark.

🎮 Express Yourself: Customize your scout with unique skins and cosmetics available in the store. More exclusive outfits and themed bundles are already in the works!

💎 Free to Play: The core experience is open to everyone. Optional purchases like skins and revive options are available for those who want to personalize their journey and support the development.

⚠️ Work in Progress: As this is an Early Access build, you might encounter some bugs or unfinished corners. Your feedback is exactly what we need to make the nights even more intense!

Join our Discord community:

💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/zZx2wxtRzv
📧 Support & Feedback: info@dream-dev.com

Thank you for being among the very first scouts to step into the woods. We have many surprises planned around the campfire.

Stay tuned, and see you in the wild!

— Scout Camp Team
